title: Detailed avocado
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Shadow/outline glow for the avocado (dark but lit colour) -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="32" ry="42" fill="#3d2b1f" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Avocado outer skin (dark green) -->
  <path d="M50 8 C30 8 16 30 16 55 C16 78 30 94 50 94 C70 94 84 78 84 55 C84 30 70 8 50 8 Z" fill="#2d5a1e"/>

  <!-- Lighter green edge for contrast -->
  <path d="M50 10 C31 10 18 31 18 55 C18 77 31 92 50 92 C69 92 82 77 82 55 C82 31 69 10 50 10 Z" fill="#3a7a28"/>

  <!-- Skin texture bumps (darker spots) -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="38" r="2.5" fill="#1e4213"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="28" r="2" fill="#1e4213"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="55" r="2.5" fill="#1e4213"/>
  <circle cx="25" cy="65" r="2" fill="#1e4213"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="80" r="2" fill="#1e4213"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="78" r="2.5" fill="#1e4213"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="20" r="1.8" fill="#1e4213"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="42" r="1.8" fill="#1e4213"/>
  <circle cx="20" cy="50" r="1.8" fill="#1e4213"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="88" r="2" fill="#1e4213"/>

  <!-- Cut avocado flesh (bright green-yellow) -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="24" ry="32" fill="#8bc34a"/>

  <!-- Inner flesh gradient (lighter yellow-green) -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="19" ry="26" fill="#c8e66a"/>

  <!-- Pit (brown, slightly lighter for visibility) -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="11" ry="13" fill="#6b3d1c"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="8" ry="9.5" fill="#8b5a2b"/>
  <!-- Pit highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="58" rx="3" ry="3.5" fill="#a8753e" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Flesh detail lines -->
  <path d="M50 29 C42 32 38 42 40 50" stroke="#9ac93f" stroke-width="1" fill="none" opacity="0.5"/>
  <path d="M50 29 C58 32 62 42 60 50" stroke="#9ac93f" stroke-width="1" fill="none" opacity="0.5"/>
  <path d="M42 75 C38 68 38 60 40 54" stroke="#9ac93f" stroke-width="1" fill="none" opacity="0.5"/>
  <path d="M58 75 C62 68 62 60 60 54" stroke="#9ac93f" stroke-width="1" fill="none" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Stem nub at top -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="9" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#5a3d1f"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="9" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#7a5a30"/>

  <!-- Cute face on the pit -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="60" r="1.8" fill="#2d1a0a"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="60" r="1.8" fill="#2d1a0a"/>
  <path d="M46 66 Q50 69 54 66" stroke="#2d1a0a" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Blush marks -->
  <ellipse cx="43" cy="64" rx="2" ry="1.2" fill="#c96b4a" opacity="0.4"/>
  <ellipse cx="57" cy="64" rx="2" ry="1.2" fill="#c96b4a" opacity="0.4"/>
</svg>
